dag_infos.description: New Taipei City criminal suspect counts by source age band, crime item and suspect gender, from the New Taipei open-data API. The 18-35 result is apportioned because the source 30-39 band crosses age 35; no rate scaling is performed.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市犯罪嫌疑犯人數（按年齡、罪名、性別）
data_infos.source_type: 新北市資料開放平臺 API
data_infos.dataset_description: 新北市犯罪嫌疑犯統計，原始欄位為民國年、年齡組、罪名、總計、men person、female person。本DAG保留所有原始年齡／罪名層級，並把全罪名總計、罪名階層總計、年齡不詳及全年齡列分成獨立 indicator_id，避免下游把合計與明細重複相加。行政區粒度不存在，統一為新北市全市 area_code=65000。
data_infos.etl_description: Paginate the data.ntpc API from page 0 until an empty page, using a browser User-Agent. Parse age labels into integer bounds; 70歲以上 has an open upper bound, 年齡不詳 and 總計 retain the raw label but have null bounds, and every unknown label raises. Parse comma-formatted counts, preserve the source total/male/female values, and reconcile the emitted gender=total sum to the input total; known source rows where total differs from male plus female are reported without inventing a correction. Emit male, female and total rows. Source crime items contain hierarchical labels ending in 總計, so item summary rows are emitted under separate indicators instead of being mixed with crime-detail rows. The source is a count, not a rate; 18-35 is apportioned only at query time because 30-39 crosses the upper boundary.
